name: Ashley River Memorial Bridge
elevationDatum: Local y=0 is the visual waterline; the runtime absolute-deck policy fits mapped ramp ends and individual support feet to terrain. The approved 7 m closed bascule and 5.70/4.80 m end heights remain photographic estimates, not a surveyed datum.
note: Current 1926 Ashley River Memorial Bridge, southbound US 17 only; adjacent T. Allen Legare Bridge excluded. OSM mapped length 528.1 m, bascule line segment 43.22 m; model hinge separation 53.3 m from mapped pier centres, interpreted as hinge supports. Four Mediterranean Revival tender houses with open octagonal lanterns; shallow concrete arches and later pier reinforcements. All vertical dimensions and ornamental sections photo-estimated; bridge is shown closed, without animation or mechanical interiors.
